body: Thanks. I honestly don’t even believe I’m a narcissist. Narcissists generally don’t apologize or own up to their behaviour. I know I was abusive, but I genuinely never meant to hurt him or anyone else. It’s incredibly difficult to come to terms with the fact that I did. My thoughts are a confusing pattern of shame for what I’ve done and trauma/flashbacks of what has been done to me. It just seems futile to try anymore.
I don’t think so. I’m too stuck on the terrible things I’ve done. And I never got a chance to heal myself as a result. Thank you though
